verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents automatic vectorization at import through integrated models, and it integrates with both self-hosted and API-based model providers, so ingest-time embedding with no separate pipeline is directly supported. The evidence never explicitly says query text is vectorized by the configured provider at search time, so only half the story is documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of query-time vectorization (e.g. text queries embedded automatically by the configured vectorizer), details on provider configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can have the database generate embeddings at ingest and query time using built-in or configured model providers, instead of running a separate embedding pipeline

citations.quote: automatic vectorization at import using integrated models
